units.source_text: “方才到院子里去，看到池里有色彩缤纷的鲤鱼，我还想：

en.t: "Just now, when I went out into the garden and saw the brilliantly colored carp in the pond, I was thinking:

units.source_text: 如果她们详细问起这个，该怎么说明才好呢。

en.t: If they ask me about them in detail, how am I supposed to explain it properly?

units.source_text: 可是她们只是夸夸鲤鱼好看就了事，无形中帮了我的大忙。

en.t: But they only said how beautiful the carp were and left it at that, which was an enormous help to me without their knowing it.

units.source_text: 关于鲤鱼的知识，我知道的不多。

en.t: I do not know very much about carp.

units.source_text: 鲤鱼的各种颜色，用英语该怎么说才确切，我也不晓得，

en.t: I also do not know exactly how to describe all the different colors of carp in English,

units.source_text: 还有带斑纹的彩色鲤鱼……”

en.t: or the multicolored carp with markings, either..."
